title: Eliminate Anvil Penalty│消除鐵砧懲罰
description: The Purification Bottle (New item) can eliminate anvil penalties; anvil penalties are visualized.│淨化之瓶（新物品）可以消除鐵砧懲罰；鐵砧懲罰可視化。
body:
# Function│功能
- The item lore will display the current repair cost of the item.│物品描述中會顯示物品當前的鐵砧懲罰。
- Drinking a **Purification Bottle** will remove the repair cost of an item in your inventory. The recipe for the **Purification Bottle** can be found in the gallery.│飲用**淨化之瓶**可以清除物品欄中一個物品的鐵砧懲罰。**淨化之瓶**的配方可在圖庫中查看。
